items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Joe Petit. Yeah, Joe Petit. All of us used to play key tramoses.

ctx.x: Yeah, Carnish, I know they say Carnish.
Yeah, Joe Petit. Yeah, Joe Petit. All of us used to play key tramoses. Because afterwards, they didn't always get in the slides.
Can you remember anything more about Deucin over across the river, Mooney? Deucin? Did he have any other job or just music?
